bodyHtml:
Summer Holiday Notice 2025｜ Aquasky

Dear valued Partners and Customers,

Aquasky will be closed for a short summer holiday break from Wednesday, 23rd July to Friday, 25th July 2025.

We will resume regular office hours on Monday, 28th July 2025.

During this period, our team will not be available to respond to emails or process orders. We kindly ask that you plan any urgent matters or requests in advance to avoid disruption to your business needs.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and sincerely appreciate your understanding.

Wishing you a wonderful and relaxing summer!
